- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser; I keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
